snippet.title: Witch The Showdown - Early Access Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Witch the Showdown is a high-difficulty parry-action game where every battle is a boss fight. Build mana through precise parries, then unleash attacks in real time using your cards—this unique combat system defines the experience.

Launching into Steam early access Nov 19th, 2026
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3103620/Witch_the_Showdown/

Also coming to PS5 & XBOX Series in 2027. Wishlist now

PS5 - https://store.playstation.com/concept/10019213/

XBOX - https://www.xbox.com/games/store/witch-the-showdown/9p21gldppngj
